playstyle.identity: Twisted Fate is a global roaming mage whose ultimate teleports him anywhere on the map. He excels at side-lane ganks and his gold card provides point-and-click CC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives extra gold on kills. Q throws cards in a line. W cycles cards - Gold stuns, Red slows and damages nearby, Blue restores mana. E gives attack speed and every 4th auto does bonus damage. R reveals all enemies and allows teleport.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Twisted Fate spikes at level 6 with global presence. Rapid Firecannon extends gold card range. He's strong with map plays.

weaknesses: R has channel that can be interrupted

passive.name: Loaded Dice
passive.details: Twisted Fate gains bonus gold each time he kills a unit.

abilities.name: Wild Cards
abilities.summary: Throw three cards in a line.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate throws three cards in a spread, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

abilities.name: Pick a Card
abilities.summary: Cycle cards; pick Gold to stun, Red to slow AoE, Blue to restore mana.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate cycles cards above his head. Selecting a card empowers his next auto: Gold stuns, Red slows and damages around target, Blue restores mana.

abilities.name: Stacked Deck
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed; every 4th attack deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Twisted Fate gains attack speed. Every fourth auto deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Destiny
abilities.summary: Reveal all enemies; recast to teleport anywhere on the map.
abilities.details: Twisted Fate reveals all enemy champions. While active, he can recast to teleport to any location on the map.
